Volute Casing Pumps
NOW 32125 ··· 200250
TECHNICAL DATA
Capacity:
2 - 740 m3/h
Head:
2 - 100 m
Speed:
up to 3600 rpm
Temperature:
up to 170℃
Casing pressure:
up to 10 bar
Shaft seal:
stuffing box or mechanical seal
Direction of rotation:
clockwise looking towards shaft end
APPLICATION
Volute casing pumps of the NOW range are used in all applica-
tions involving the trouble-free handling of clean or turbid.
non-aggressive liquids which do not contain any solid consti-
tuents. Hence they are suitable for
drinking water supply of local communities
general water supply duty in agriculture, trade and industry
irrigation and draining
spray irrigation
handling of brine and lye
circulating high temperature water up to 170 ℃, cooling
water and oil in heating and cooling circuits
Thanks to exceptionally favourable NPSH, pumps of the NOW
range are also used with advantage for
handling condensate.
DESIGN
Horizontal, single-stage volute casing pumps with dimensions
and nominal ratings to DIN 24 255 based on the process prin-
ciple, plus 24 additional sizes (NOW and WTS ranges),
The process principle allows dismantling of the complete bea-
ring unit towards the drive end without the pump casing having
to be disconnected from the piping. It a spacer type coupling
is used it is also unnecessary to disconnect the motor.
Through use of the building block principle, the range requires
only three bearing housings. Within a given shaft unit, shaft.
shaft seal, impeller nut and bearings are interchangeable.
1
STERLING
SIHI
SIHI-HALBERG
DESIGN DETAILS
Casing pressure:
Up to 10 bar respectively from -10℃ to 120 ℃
Up to 9 bar respectively from 120 ℃ to 170 ℃
Branch positions:
Suction branch axial, discharge branch radially upwards.
Flanges:
The flanges conform to DIN 2532 PN 10. Flanges drilled to
ANSI.
Bearings:
Bearing brackets 25 and 35: two deep groove ball bearings
in accordance with DIN 625
Bearing bracket 45: one twin row angular contact ball
bearing in accordance with DIN 628 at the pump end, and
one deep groove ball bearing in accordance with DIN 625
at the drive end.
Oil lubrication.
Designation of the above pump type execution: C
Grease lubrication of the bearings is possible.
Designation of the above pump type execution: B
Direction of rotation:
Clockwise as viewed from the drive towards the pump.
Shaft sealing:
Sealing of the shaft can be effected either by a stuffing box
or mechanical seal, as required.
Designation 041: Self-sealed, uncooled stuffing box.
Temperature range: - 10℃ to 110 ℃
Designation 051: Uncooled stuffing box with sealing fluid
from an outside source and flushing.
Temperature range: - 10 °℃ to 110 °℃
Designation 501: Soft packed stuffing box with super-
imposed cooling compartment for the
intensive cooling of the seal unit
Temperature range: up to 170 ℃
Designation BKW: Unbalanced single mechanical seal of
elastomeric bellows design, NBR,
with self-contained circulation.
Temperature range: from -10℃ to 60 ℃
Designation BKS: Unbalanced single mechanical seal
with elastomeric bellows, FKM,
with self-contained circulation.
Temperature range: from -10 ℃ to 60 ℃
Designation BK3: Unbalanced single mechanical seal of
elastomeric bellows design, EPDM,
with self-contained circulation.
Temperature range: from -10 ℃ to 110 ℃
